messages.subject: Re: Thanks for your support
messages.text:
Thanks, Gabriel. 

 I reviewed your online catalogue and I am interested in your products. I felt discouraged, however, to read multiple comments saying the buyer was disappointed. More than one says they bought a neck warmer that does not fit but there is only one size. I saw two comments that say the quality of the sewing is not consistently good.
 Wishing you much success!
 

 Kirk Vandezande
Toronto
 

 416-662-5597

 On Thu, Jan 1, 2026 at 3:40 PM Lasclay <hey@lasclay.com> wrote:

 Hi Kirk, I'm Gabriel, co-founder of Lasclay.

 Thank you so much for your interest in our business and for signing up for our newsletter!

 It touches me personally. I have been working slowly on this project for years, without making too much noise about it, wondering if other people were also fascinated by this beautiful, fragile native plant. Catching your interest in this project warms my heart.

 We’re building a responsible company, both environmentally and humanly, from harvest all the way to your hands. Our mission is clear: to craft high quality milkweed-insulated products that are lightweight, efficient, affordable and elegant.

 Our ambition is to democratize milkweed silk as a high-performing, ethical, eco-friendly and local insulation material while supporting organic milkweed farmers in North America, along the monarch butterflies migratory route, and protecting our ecosystems’ biodiversity. If you share our passion for milkweed and monarch butterflies or simply if our ethical and eco-conscious values resonate with you, we warmly invite you to have a look at our website on the link below, where you can find our product catalog and a lot of information about milkweed, biodiversity and our business philosophy: 

 https://lasclay.com/milkweed-products (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KDXMKWVG1GNKEHKESVJBFTK3_0)

 Oh and if you haven't already done so, I also invite you to add us to your email contacts and to follow us on Facebook and Instagram, to stay up to date with our company’s latest developments (@lasclay). Don’t worry, we don’t write too often and never send anything unless it’s useful.

 Thanks again Kirk, you have no idea how much your support is appreciated.

 Gabriel 
Co-founder, Lasclay

 -
